text.zh: 全身的动脉血都从同一根管子出发。它从心脏出来先向上，拐个弯，再一路向下穿过躯干。
text.en: All the arterial blood in your body sets out from a single tube. It leaves the heart heading up, arches over, then runs straight down through the torso.

text.zh: 这就是主动脉，全身最粗的动脉。管壁里织着大量弹性纤维，两次心跳之间它靠回弹继续推血。
text.en: This is the aorta, the widest artery you have. Its wall is woven with elastic fibres, so between heartbeats it keeps blood moving by springing back.

text.zh: 弓顶上第一个岔口叫头臂干，粗短得像个转接头。这个岔口只有右边有——左边的两根血管，是各自单独从弓上开的口。
text.en: The first turning at the top of the arch is the brachiocephalic trunk, short and stout as an adaptor. Only the right side has it: on the left, the two vessels each open straight off the arch.

text.zh: 颈总动脉贴着气管两侧笔直上行。指腹搭在喉结外侧那道沟里，就能感到它一下下顶着皮肤。
text.en: The common carotid arteries run straight up either side of the windpipe. Lay a fingertip in the groove beside the Adam's apple and you will feel it nudging the skin, beat after beat.

text.zh: 腹腔干短到几乎看不出是一段血管，更像主动脉侧壁上直接开的一个口。就这么一小截，供着肝、胃和脾三家。
text.en: The coeliac trunk is so short it hardly reads as a length of vessel at all — more like a hole opened straight in the aortic wall. That stub alone supplies liver, stomach and spleen.

text.zh: 紧接着是左右肾动脉，几乎成直角横插出去，短得像两根接头——肾就挂在主动脉的正两侧。
text.en: Next come the renal arteries, striking off almost at right angles and short as a pair of couplings — the kidneys hang directly off either flank of the aorta.

text.zh: 走到肚脐这个高度，主动脉就此终止，分成左右两条髂动脉。这里是整条干线的终点，也是双腿的起点。
text.en: At about the level of the navel the aorta ends, splitting in two as the iliac arteries. This is where the main line stops and both legs begin.

text.zh: 越过腹股沟，它换名叫股动脉。这根血管位置浅、口径大，医生既在这里摸脉，做心导管时也从这里穿刺进去。
text.en: Crossing the groin, it takes a new name: the femoral artery. Shallow and wide, it is a vessel medics reach for to feel a pulse, and the usual entry point for a cardiac catheter.

text.zh: 一根主干，沿路不断分岔，越分越细。血从心脏到脚趾，只有一条路，却有无数个出口。
text.en: One trunk, branching and rebranching, finer at every step. From heart to toe there is only one road — but countless places to leave it.
